## Overview

Part of the [**Data Science Projects Collection**](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-) (Moto price prediction with streamlit app)—Motorbike price prediction with an interactive Streamlit front end for live estimates.

## Problem & Data

Used moto buyers need instant fair-price estimates from bike attributes.

## Approach

Train regression on historical listings; deploy Streamlit UI for user inputs and predicted price output.

## Technologies

Python · scikit-learn · Streamlit · pandas · Jupyter

## Outcomes

Interactive app delivering on-demand price predictions for common moto configurations.
